purpose: Small variations of the preferred LLM lettermark; original retained.

concepts.title: A · More open spacing
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. This is a very small refinement of the supplied LLMLean logo, NOT a redesign. The user likes this exact geometric LLM monogram: two nested dark navy L shapes and a muted blue M fitted into the upper-right, with the bold navy LLMLean wordmark to the right. Preserve that concept, every letter, the exact spelling and capitalization "LLMLean", the navy/blue colors, the white background, horizontal composition, and flat vector-friendly finish. Preserve the exact wordmark font and its letter spacing unless specifically told otherwise. Output one logo at the same wide aspect ratio with similarly balanced margins. No labels, captions, taglines, extra symbols, gradients, textures, shadows, effects, or mockup surfaces. All shapes must be crisp and intentional. Make ONLY the subtle change described below, so it can be compared directly against the original. Variation A: give the monogram slightly more breathing room. Increase the white channels separating the two nested Ls and the blue M by about 20 percent, while keeping the emblem's outer dimensions and its original stroke weights approximately the same. This may require tiny adjustments to the inner L lengths and M placement. Keep the three letters clearly readable and do not let any strokes touch. Keep the gap between emblem and wordmark unchanged. The overall result should feel almost identical, just less crowded and more legible when small.
